subject: Request: one-time PoC runway replenishment for HealthNova
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@healthnova.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick check – PoC timing and credits

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. We hit a regulatory hold with our security team (new privacy addendum review) that pushed our integration work back by ~4 weeks. Given the delay, can Redwood extend our PoC window by 60 days and grant an additional $25k in platform credits to cover the burst of inference during the extended evaluation?

We’d like to avoid restarting the trial later; the extension keeps momentum. Procurement is on standby if we can agree to a one-time exception and an updated SOW. I attached a short note from our security manager.

—Samir
Head of Product, HealthNova
attachments: HealthNova_Security_Note.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@healthnova.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick check – PoC timing and credits

Samir —

Really appreciate the update and the context. Totally understand the delay — happy to escalate this internally for an exception. I’ve looped in Jordan and Marissa from Deal Desk to review a 60-day extension + $25k one-time credit.

Can you confirm two quick things so we can speed the internal review: 1) confirm the expected peak token/hour during the extended period (ballpark is fine), and 2) confirm that procurement can sign an addendum to the existing SOW rather than a new contract.

I’ll get back to you with a timeline for a decision by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: HealthNova — request for 60d PoC extension + $25k credit (deal DN-9472)

Team —

Summary: HealthNova (mid-market health-tech) is requesting a one-time exception: 60-day extension to their PoC and $25k in free credits. They hit a regulatory review that paused their integration work. Current PLG limits have been exceeded given the extension timeline.

Why approve:
- Strategic fit: HealthNova is integrating Redwood into a regulated clinical workflow; if successful this is a likely expansion path and a referenceable case for healthcare vertical.
- Usage signal: Q2 usage shows steady ramp; their estimated peak during extension is ~1.2M tokens/day (~3–4 concurrent sessions). I’ve attached the Q2 usage export.
- Procurement posture: procurement is ready to sign an addendum immediately if we approve; they prefer an addendum vs new contract.

Proposed one-time terms (recommended):
- 60-day PoC extension from contract expiry
- $25,000 one-time platform credit applyable only to this PoC (no transfer)
- Updated SOW addendum that documents extension window and success criteria
- No change to list pricing or future commercial terms; credits expire on PoC completion

Risk & mitigations:
- Abuse risk: low — account has KYC, we can limit by account-level token caps and set alerts for unusual token spikes.
- Precedent: set as a one-time, non-precedent-setting exception; include explicit language in addendum.

Asks:
- Marissa: can Deal Desk approve the credit and draft the addendum language?
- Jordan: executive sign-off for the one-time credit exception?

Attachments: healthnova_usage_q2.csv, healthnova_po_extension_request.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: HealthNova — request for 60d PoC extension + $25k credit (deal DN-9472)

All —

I’m comfortable approving a one-time, conditional runway replenishment for HealthNova under the proposed guardrails. Approve the $25k credit and 60-day extension with the following mandatory conditions:
1) Addendum must include explicit non-precedent language and approval stamp (Deal Desk + CRO)
2) Apply a soft token cap at 2M/day for the extension window and configure alerting to myself + Sofia if utilization exceeds 90% of that cap
3) Procurement must sign the addendum within 7 business days; otherwise credit is void
4) Post-PoC: AE to submit a short post-mortem (metrics + decision) within 10 days of completion

Marissa — please draft the addendum and prepare a DocuSign. Sofia — send Samir the conditional approval and next steps; copy procurement.

Jordan Blake
Head of Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
